verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ يَهْرُبُ وَلَا طَارِدَ، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ فَكَشِبْلٍ ثَبِيتٍ.
verses.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

verses.ar: لِمَعْصِيَةِ أَرْضٍ تَكْثُرُ رُؤَسَاؤُهَا، لَكِنْ بِذِي فَهْمٍ وَمَعْرِفَةٍ تَدُومُ.
verses.kjv: For the transgression of a land many [are] the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding [and] knowledge the state [thereof] shall be prolonged.
verses.web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلْفَقِيرُ ٱلَّذِي يَظْلِمُ فُقَرَاءَ، هُوَ مَطَرٌ جَارِفٌ لَا يُبْقِي طَعَامًا.
verses.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor [is like] a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

verses.ar: تَارِكُو ٱلشَّرِيعَةِ يَمْدَحُونَ ٱلْأَشْرَارَ، وَحَافِظُو ٱلشَّرِيعَةِ يُخَاصِمُونَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

verses.ar: اَلنَّاسُ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ لَا يَفْهَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ، وَطَالِبُو ٱلرَّبِّ يَفْهَمُونَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ.
verses.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all [things].
verses.web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.

verses.ar: اَلْفَقِيرُ ٱلسَّالِكُ بِٱسْتِقَامَتِهِ، خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُعْوَجِّ ٱلطُّرُقِ وَهُوَ غَنِيٌّ.
verses.kjv: Better [is] the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than [he that is] perverse [in his] ways, though he [be] rich.
verses.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

verses.ar: اَلْحَافِظُ ٱلشَّرِيعَةَ هُوَ ٱبْنٌ فَهِيمٌ، وَصَاحِبُ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ يُخْجِلُ أَبَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law [is] a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous [men] shameth his father.
verses.web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

verses.ar: اَلْمُكْثِرُ مَالَهُ بِٱلرِّبَا وَٱلْمُرَابَحَةِ، فَلِمَنْ يَرْحَمُ ٱلْفُقَرَاءَ يَجْمَعُهُ.
verses.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُحَوِّلُ أُذْنَهُ عَنْ سَمَاعِ ٱلشَّرِيعَةِ، فَصَلَاتُهُ أَيْضًا مَكْرَهَةٌ.
verses.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer [shall be] abomination.
verses.web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُضِلُّ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ فِي طَرِيقٍ رَدِيئَةٍ فَفِي حُفْرَتِهِ يَسْقُطُ هُوَ، أَمَّا ٱلْكَمَلَةُ فَيَمْتَلِكُونَ خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good [things] in possession.
verses.web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلْغَنِيُّ حَكِيمٌ فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ، وَٱلْفَقِيرُ ٱلْفَهِيمُ يَفْحَصُهُ.
verses.kjv: The rich man [is] wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

verses.ar: إِذَا فَرِحَ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ عَظُمَ ٱلْفَخْرُ، وَعِنْدَ قِيَامِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تَخْتَفِي ٱلنَّاسُ.
verses.kjv: When righteous [men] do rejoice, [there is] great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَكْتُمُ خَطَايَاهُ لَا يَنْجَحُ، وَمَنْ يُقِرُّ بِهَا وَيَتْرُكُهَا يُرْحَمُ.
verses.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh [them] shall have mercy.
verses.web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلْمُتَّقِي دَائِمًا، أَمَّا ٱلْمُقَسِّي قَلْبَهُ فَيَسْقُطُ فِي ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: Happy [is] the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

verses.ar: أَسَدٌ زَائِرٌ وَدُبٌّ ثَائِرٌ، ٱلْمُتَسَلِّطُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ عَلَى شَعْبٍ فَقِيرٍ.
verses.kjv: [As] a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; [so is] a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

verses.ar: رَئِيسٌ نَاقِصُ ٱلْفَهْمِ وَكَثِيرُ ٱلْمَظَالِمِ. مُبْغِضُ ٱلرَّشْوَةِ تَطُولُ أَيَّامُهُ.
verses.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding [is] also a great oppressor: [but] he that hateth covetousness shall prolong [his] days.
verses.web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلْمُثَقَّلُ بِدَمِ نَفْسٍ، يَهْرُبُ إِلَى ٱلْجُبِّ. لَا يُمْسِكَنَّهُ أَحَدٌ.
verses.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of [any] person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.web: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

verses.ar: اَلسَّالِكُ بِٱلْكَمَالِ يَخْلُصُ، وَٱلْمُلْتَوِي فِي طَرِيقَيْنِ يَسْقُطُ فِي إِحْدَاهُمَا.
verses.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but [he that is] perverse [in his] ways shall fall at once.
verses.web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

verses.ar: اَلْمُشْتَغِلُ بِأَرْضِهِ يَشْبَعُ خُبْزًا، وَتَابِعُ ٱلْبَطَّالِينَ يَشْبَعُ فَقْرًا.
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain [persons] shall have poverty enough.
verses.web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلْأَمِينُ كَثِيرُ ٱلْبَرَكَاتِ، وَٱلْمُسْتَعْجِلُ إِلَى ٱلْغِنَى لَا يُبْرَأُ.
verses.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

verses.ar: مُحَابَاةُ ٱلْوُجُوهِ لَيْسَتْ صَالِحَةً، فَيُذْنِبُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ لِأَجْلِ كِسْرَةِ خُبْزٍ.
verses.kjv: To have respect of persons [is] not good: for for a piece of bread [that] man will transgress.
verses.web: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

verses.ar: ذُو ٱلْعَيْنِ ٱلشِّرِّيرَةِ يَعْجَلُ إِلَى ٱلْغِنَى، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ٱلْفَقْرَ يَأْتِيهِ.
verses.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich [hath] an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُوَبِّخُ إِنْسَانًا يَجِدُ أَخِيرًا نِعْمَةً أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلْمُطْرِي بِٱللِّسَانِ.
verses.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

verses.ar: ٱلسَّالِبُ أَبَاهُ أَوْ أُمَّهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «لَا بَأْسَ» فَهُوَ رَفِيقٌ لِرَجُلٍ مُخْرِبٍ.
verses.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, [It is] no transgression; the same [is] the companion of a destroyer.
verses.web: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

verses.ar: اَلْمُنْتَفِخُ ٱلنَّفْسُ يُهَيِّجُ ٱلْخِصَامَ، وَٱلْمُتَّكِلُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ يُسَمَّنُ.
verses.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

verses.ar: اَلْمُتَّكِلُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ هُوَ جَاهِلٌ، وَٱلسَّالِكُ بِحِكْمَةٍ هُوَ يَنْجُو.
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُعْطِي ٱلْفَقِيرَ لَا يَحْتَاجُ، وَلِمَنْ يَحْجِبُ عَنْهُ عَيْنَيْهِ لَعَنَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ.
verses.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

verses.ar: عِنْدَ قِيَامِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تَخْتَبِئُ ٱلنَّاسُ، وَبِهَلَاكِهِمْ يَكْثُرُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ.
verses.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
